name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, the master smith Galvan the Ancient works to fashion specialized armament capable of striking down powerful demons. This forging provides an enchanted weapon imbued with the Felcurse, designed specifically to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his servitors.

sections.title: A Weapon Against the Defiler
sections.body: Galvan the Ancient requires patience while he works his craft just south of the path leading into Zul'Gurub. Rushing the forging risks creating a flawed blade, staff, or dagger. Once completed, the chosen weapon carries the power of the Felcurse, which can be unleashed periodically to weaken Razelikh the Defiler and his demonic underlings. The duration of this debilitating curse can vary.

faq.answer: Galvan the Ancient, a master smith found south of the road leading toward Zul'Gurub in Stranglethorn Vale, crafts the weaponry.

faq.q: What power does the forged weapon hold?
faq.answer: The weapon channels the Felcurse, a specialized magic meant to weaken the demon Razelikh the Defiler and his demonic minions. Its weakening effects vary in length.

faq.q: Where does the journey lead after the weapon is forged?
faq.answer: Once Galvan finishes the craftsmanship and presents the finished weapon, the path directs you back with Return to the Blasted Lands.
